# Spike: headless `claude` CLI on hoid (M0-4a)

Status: **install pending** (Brendan is running the installer himself). The flag table below is a PRELIMINARY run against
the Mac's `2.1.312`, and will be redone on hoid with the installed version.

## Install recipe (native, no sudo)

Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup ("Install a specific version"):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash -s stable     # channel; or `bash -s <X.Y.Z>` to pin
```

What the installer does (reviewed `install.sh`, 260 lines, sha256 `3a68d3406cf674e17bed1733a4dcf37805e2e47d87417700007d7e1aa766a944`
as fetched 2026-10-28):
- Refuses to run under sudo. Everything goes under `$HOME`.
- Downloads `https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/latest` → version → `manifest.json`, then the
  `linux-x64` binary into `~/.claude/downloads/`, and verifies its sha256 against the manifest. Uses curl or wget; jq and zstd are optional.
- Runs `<binary> install stable`, which writes the launcher symlink `~/.local/bin/claude` → `~/.local/share/claude/versions/<ver>`,
  then deletes the download.
- The channel given at install time becomes the auto-update channel. Native installs **auto-update in the background**.

For the finbot image (M1/M3), pin the version and turn updates off:
```dockerfile
RUN curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash -s <PINNED_VERSION>
ENV DISABLE_UPDATES=1          # blocks background AND manual updates (DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER only stops background)
```
Optional hardening: verify `manifest.json.sig` with the Anthropic release key (fingerprint
`31DD DE24 DDFA B679 F42D 7BD2 BAA9 29FF 1A7E CACE`) per the setup page's "Binary integrity" section.

### What actually happened on hoid
- Pre-state (2026-10-28): no `~/.claude`, no `~/.claude.json`, no `~/.local/bin` (`~/.local/{share,state}` already existed).
  rc md5s: `.bashrc 1f98b8f3…dcc1c6`, `.profile f4e81ade…7d6f9fb3`.
- PATH for non-interactive ssh: `~/.bashrc` returns early for non-interactive shells (`case $- in *i*) ;; *) return;;`),
  so any PATH line must go **above** that guard, or the finbot runner calls `~/.local/bin/claude` by absolute path.

## Flag table (§5a)

Generated by `spikes/claude/check_flags.sh` (no auth needed). **PRELIMINARY: Mac 2.1.312**, hoid run pending.

| Flag | Present | Help text (verbatim, joined) |
|---|---|---|
| `-p` | yes | -p, --print Print response and exit (useful for pipes). Note: The workspace trust dialog is skipped when Claude is run in non-interactive mode … Settings files that fail validation are silently ignored in this mode (no error dialog is shown). |
| `--output-format json` | yes | --output-format <format> Output format (only works with --print): "text" (default), "json" (single result), or "stream-json" (realtime streaming) (choices: "text", "json", "stream-json") |
| `--tools` | yes | --tools <tools...> Specify the list of available tools from the built-in set. Use "" to disable all tools, "default" to use the default set, or specify tool names (e.g. "Bash,Edit,Read"). |
| `--strict-mcp-config` | yes | --strict-mcp-config Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations |
| `--mcp-config` | yes | --mcp-config <configs...> Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated) |
| `--allowedTools` | yes | --allowedTools, --allowed-tools <tools...> Comma or space-separated list of tool names to allow (e.g. "Bash(git *) Edit") |
| `--json-schema` | yes | --json-schema <schema> JSON Schema for structured output validation (only works with --print). |
| `--permission-prompts` | yes | --permission-prompts <target> Who answers permission prompts with --print: "host" (the SDK host or --permission-prompt-tool) or "none" (nobody: anything that would prompt is denied automatically; the permission mode still decides everything else) (choices: "host", "none", default: "host") |
| `--setting-sources` | yes | --setting-sources <sources> Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local). |
| `--disable-slash-commands` | yes | --disable-slash-commands Disable all skills and commands |
| `--append-system-prompt-file` | **hidden** | Not listed as its own option. It is only mentioned inside `--bare`'s help ("Explicitly provide context via: --system-prompt[-file], --append-system-prompt[-file], …"). The headless docs list it too (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless, bare-mode table). `--append-system-prompt <prompt>` is listed. |
| `--resume` | yes | -r, --resume [value] Resume a conversation by session ID or name, or open interactive picker with optional search term |
| `--system-prompt-snapshot` | yes | --system-prompt-snapshot <on\|off> Record the system prompt once per conversation and reuse it verbatim on every request and resume. on (the default, except under --bare …): … every later request and resume sends the record as-is, even when a later launch passes different text, until the conversation is compacted. off: never record; the prompt is rendered fresh every request … |
| `--bare` | yes | --bare Minimal mode: skip hooks …, LSP, plugin sync, attribution, auto-memory, background prefetches, keychain reads, and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery. Sets CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1. Anthropic auth is strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or apiKeyHelper via --settings (OAuth and keychain are never read). … |
| `setup-token` | yes (command) | setup-token Set up a long-lived authentication token (requires Claude subscription) |
| **Model selection** | | |
| `--model` | yes | --model <model> Model for the current session. Provide an alias for the latest model (e.g. 'fable', 'opus', or 'sonnet') or a model's full name. |
| `--fallback-model` | yes | --fallback-model <model> Enable automatic fallback to specified model(s) when the default model is overloaded or not available. Accepts a comma-separated list to try each in order. Re-tries the primary at the start of each user turn. |

Notes:
- **Renamed / replaced flags:** none. `--append-system-prompt-file` is hidden from the option list but referenced, so it
  probably works. M0-4b confirms it.
- **Model:** `--help` gives the aliases `fable`, `opus`, `sonnet` as examples, "or a model's full name". It does **not**
  mention `haiku`. Fallback if the alias is rejected: the full id `claude-haiku-5-5`. Also possible: the `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`
  env var, or `"model"` in a `--settings` file. M0-4b must confirm `--model haiku` headless.
- `--setting-sources` documents only `user, project, local`. Whether `""` (load none) is accepted is a runtime check.
- `--resume` takes an ID **or name**, so finbot should always pass the UUID `session_id` from the JSON output.
- `--system-prompt-snapshot`'s default `on` would freeze the first turn's appended prompt. That is why §5a sets `off`.

## Auth notes (from docs; relevant to §5a)

- `claude setup-token` → "a one-year OAuth token". Set it as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. "It can only make model requests …
  MCP servers you configure locally still work." (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication#generate-a-long-lived-token)
- "Bare mode does not read `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`." This confirms §5a's NOT `--bare`.
- Credential precedence: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` outranks `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, and "in non-interactive mode (-p), the key is
  always used when present". So the finbot env must **not** contain `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, or calls bill to the API.
- Token TTL is documented as one year. Keep §5a's daily auth probe anyway (revocation, plan changes).

## M0-4b runtime checklist (needs `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` from BA-6)

1. Auth probe: `claude -p --model haiku --output-format json --tools "" "say ok"` → exit 0, `.result`, `.session_id`. Record latency.
2. **`--model haiku` works headless**: the JSON `modelUsage` keys (or `/status`-equivalent) show a Haiku id. If the alias is rejected, try
   `claude-haiku-5-5` and record which form works.
3. `--json-schema` output shape: `.structured_output` is present and valid against the schema. Record what the JSON looks like
   when the model declines (no `structured_output` field).
4. Classifier invocation exactly as in §5a (`--tools "" --strict-mcp-config`, no `--mcp-config`): `system/init` shows zero tools and zero MCP servers.
5. `--resume <id>` with a **new** `--mcp-config` (different bearer token) on turn 2: the new server or token is used (check
   the server-side auth log). This is the §5a open question.
6. `--permission-prompts none`: call a tool not in `--allowedTools` → denied without hanging. Check `permission_denials` in the
   result. Measure wall-clock time against a run without the flag.
7. `--append-system-prompt-file <path>` is accepted (hidden flag) and its content takes effect.
8. `--setting-sources ""` is accepted (or find the equivalent), and a `~/.claude/settings.json` hook does not fire.
9. `--system-prompt-snapshot off` + `--resume`: a changed appended prompt on turn 2 takes effect.
10. Latency: p50/p95 over ~10 calls for the classifier path and the Slack path (§5a expects 5–30s).
11. `DISABLE_UPDATES=1` honoured: `claude doctor` shows updates disabled.
